title: General Translation costs
subtitle: Simple annual cost estimate for Civic Cycle
summary: Budget about $49.48 per year for translation and meeting-summary AI at current usage: one full four-language website translation, AI summaries for 123 meetings, and each meeting summary translated once into all four target languages. General Translation's Starter platform fee is $0. Hosting, database plans, human review, taxes, and engineering labor are excluded.

blocks.title: Simple assumptions
blocks.text: 123 meetings is Civic Cycle's observed meeting volume over the last 365 days; 96 are currently summarized. AI average comes from 13,035 recorded calls across 2,506 meetings. Meeting-translation size is estimated from 1,745 stored summaries at about four characters per token. Cache hits cost no additional GT Runtime translation, so repeat page views are not charged again.

blocks.title: Not included
blocks.text: Hosting, Supabase plan fees, taxes, human language review, engineering maintenance, retries, and optional GT Platform Context. Actual General Translation allowance and invoice credits remain account-specific.
